result.title: Detector-Integrated Multi-Cue Association for Occlusion-Aware UAV Multi-Object Tracking
result.summary: Multi-object tracking (MOT) in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery is challenging because vehicles are small, visually similar, and frequently occluded, which leads to identity switches (IDSW). Appearance-based trackers such as DeepSORT rely on a standalone re-identification (ReID) network, whose per-target inference limits runtime speed, while the appearance of small or occluded vehicles remains unreliable. This paper proposes a detector-integrated multi-cue tracking framework. Lightweight projection heads are attached to the neck of the YOLOv8n detector to extract target embeddings through ROIAlign, producing detections and embeddings in a single forward pass. A multi-cue association cost then combines motion, IoU, and appearance distances with weights determined through ablation, complemented by low-score rescue and appearance-memory protection. On the UAVDT benchmark, the proposed method achieves a MOTA of 28.33, a HOTA of 31.16, and an IDF1 of 38.18 at 82.59 FPS, the best among the compared trackers in all three metrics, and reduces IDSW by 58.4\% compared with DeepSORT.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向无人机影像中的多目标跟踪，在 YOLOv8n 颈部接入轻量投影头，用 ROIAlign 在单次前向中同时得到检测与嵌入，并以运动、IoU、外观距离加权关联，辅以低分召回与外观记忆保护。
AI.relevance_reason: 内容属于检测器集成的多目标跟踪工程优化（速度与 IDSW），不涉及 VLM 推理、latent 状态生成或证据使用；其外观记忆与多线索代价虽提及“记忆”，但服务于跨帧 ID 关联而非推理状态，缺乏可核查的具体借鉴线索。
